KLH LAW SCHOOL PORTAL

Privacy & storage

How this portal handles browser storage, hosting data, and external links.

Effective and last updated: September 20, 2026

What the portal stores

The portal has no accounts and does not ask you to submit personal information. It stores two preferences only in your current browser:

  • Study status (klh-study-v1): the stable case identifiers you bookmark or mark as read.
  • Theme preference (klh-theme-v1): whether you selected light or dark mode.

Portal code does not send these preferences to KLH, the professor, or the school. They remain on this browser and device until you clear them.

Cookies, tracking, and forms

The portal does not set cookies and does not use analytics, advertising pixels, behavioral profiling, third-party embeds, or session replay. It has no registration, contact, payment, or submission forms. Because there are no optional tracking cookies or similar technologies to accept, the portal does not show a cookie-consent banner.

Hosting information

The public site is hosted by Vercel. Like other web hosts, Vercel may process technical request information such as an IP address, approximate location derived from it, browser or device information, timestamps, and system logs to deliver and secure the site. That processing is described in Vercel’s Privacy Notice. The portal owner has not added Vercel Web Analytics.

External case links

Case pages link to court, government, and legal-archive websites. They open as separate sites and are not embedded here. Those sites may have their own privacy practices.

Your choices and questions

You may use the portal without bookmarks or reading progress. You can remove browser-only data with the button above or by clearing this site’s storage in your browser. For a privacy question about this portal, contact Atty. Keinth Laña Horario, CPA through the official School of Law consultation channel described in the syllabus. You may also learn about data-subject rights from the National Privacy Commission.
